stories.title: Kardashian curves: M&S launches £28 bodysuit with exaggerated hip padding
stories.summary: The ‘hip boost’ aims to create hourglass silhouette, much like Kim Kardashian’s shapewear brand’s padded shorts For decades shapewear has been used to compress and cinch. But now there is a sub-genre emerging. Rather than shrinking a silhouette, it aims to add inches. This week M&S launched a bodysuit that features exaggerated padding at the hip allowing the wearer to create an hourglass shape, or at least the illusion of one. Continue reading...

stories.title: Black-clad protesters in balaclavas block road at port of Dover in Kent
stories.summary: Port authorities say access roads ‘free flowing’ again after large group forces road closures in both directions Dozens of people dressed in black and wearing balaclavas blocked the road at the port of Dover in Kent, forcing closures in both directions on Saturday morning. Kent police said they were were in attendance and engaging with the protest, which the Port of Dover described as a “public order incident”. No arrests were made during the incident. Responsibility for the demonstration appears to have been claimed by an anti-immigration group with links to the far right. Continue reading...
stories.headline: Black-clad protesters in balaclavas block road at port of Dover in Kent

opening: Port authorities say access roads ‘free flowing’ again after large group forces road closures in both directions.
Dozens of people dressed in black and wearing balaclavas blocked the road at the port of Dover in Kent, forcing closures in both directions on Saturday morning.
body: Kent police said they were in attendance and engaging with the protest, which the Port of Dover described as a “public order incident”.
No arrests were made during the incident.
